[Verse 1]
[D]Joan was quizzical,
[D#dim]studied pataphysical
[Em]Science in the home
[A]Late nights all alone
with a test tube
[D]Oh, oh, oh, oh
[A]
[D]Maxwell Edison,
[D#dim]majoring in medicine
[Em]Calls her on the phone
[A]"Can I take you out
to the pictures
[D]Joa, oa, oa, oan?"
[A]But

[Pre-Chorus]
[E]as she's getting read-
y to go A
[A]knock comes on the door

[Chorus]
[D]Bang! Bang! Maxwell's
silver hammer Came
[E]down upon her head
[A]Bang! Bang! Maxwell's
silver hammer Made
[Em]sure that [A]she was dead
[D]

[Bridge]
[D]  [A#dim]
[Bm]  [D7/C]
[G]

[Verse 2]
[D]Back in school again
[D#dim]Maxwell plays the fool again
[Em]Teacher gets annoyed
[A]Wishing to avoid
and unpleasant
[D]Sce, e, e, ene
[A]
[D]She tells Max to stay
[D#dim]when the class has gone away
[Em]So he waits behind
[A]Writing fifty times
"I must not be
[D]So, o, o, o"
[A]But

[Pre-Chorus]
[E]when she turns her back
on the boy He
[A]creeps up from behind

[Chorus]
[D]Bang! Bang! Maxwell's
silver hammer Came
[E]down upon her head
[A]Bang! Bang! Maxwell's
silver hammer Made
[Em]sure that she was dead
[A]

[Guitar Solo]
[D]
[E]
[A]
[Em]
[D]

[Bridge]
[D]  [A#dim]
[Bm]  [D7/C]
[G]

[Verse 3]
[D]P. C. Thirtyone
[D#dim]said, "We caught a dirty one"
[Em]Maxwell stands alone
[A]Painting testimon-
ial pictures
[D]Oh, oh, oh, oh
[A]
[D]Rose and Valerie,
[D#dim]screaming from the gallery
[Em]Say he must go free
The
[A]judge does not agree
and he tells them
[D]So, o, o, o
[A]But

[Pre-Chorus]
[E]as the words are leav-
ing his lips A
[A]noise comes from behind

[Chorus]
[D]Bang! Bang! Maxwell's
silver hammer Came
[E]down upon his head
[A]Bang! Bang! Maxwell's
silver hammer Made
[Em]sure that he was dead
[A]

[Synth Solo]
[D]
[E]
[A]
[Em]
[D]

[Outro]
[A#dim][D]Silver
[D7/C][Bm]hammer
[G]Max
[A]  [D]
title: Maxwell's Silver Hammer
tuning: E A D G B E
